* A Listener interface that can be attached to a RecylcerView to get notified
     * whenever a ViewHolder is attached to or detached from RecyclerView.

methods.name: void onChildViewAttachedToWindow(@NonNull View view)
methods.comment:
* Called when a view is attached to the RecyclerView.
         *
         * @param view The View which is attached to the RecyclerView

methods.name: void onChildViewDetachedFromWindow(@NonNull View view)
methods.comment:
* Called when a view is detached from RecyclerView.
         *
         * @param view The View which is being detached from the RecyclerView
